corrected_ipda.v2_derivation: Third independent re-derivation from the isophorone diamine constitution (Lee & Neville 1967): cyclohexane ring; C1 quaternary carbon bearing an exocyclic aminomethyl group and a methyl; C3 bearing the ring primary amine; C5 gem-dimethyl. Written starting from the exocyclic aminomethyl carbon -- R-A07 started from the ring primary-amine carbon and V-A07 from the gem-dimethyl carbon -- so this string is not a transcription of either.

headline: R-A07v2 republishes the complete four-family conformal novelty table on the deduplicated 350-distinct OpenPoly calibration corpus with the corrected isophorone diamine structure (CAS 2855-13-2, C10H22N2) propagated into ALL FOUR fingerprint families -- morgan_r2_2048, maccs_166, atompair_2048 and toptorsion_2048 -- not only into the morgan-only side table R-A07 shipped. Every flip is disclosed: 5 cells flip from the originally-signed contaminated-443 table to the deduplicated table (R-A07's declared set, reproduced exactly), and 1 further cell -- atompair_2048 / IPDA / alpha=0.01 -- flips when the IPDA structural fix is actually applied in that family, the undisclosed flip V-A07 surfaced. Relative to what was ORIGINALLY signed, 4 cells differ under the fully-corrected table. THE TOP-LEVEL 5/5-NOVEL HEADLINE STANDS: on the deduplicated corpus with the corrected structure, all 5 candidates have Morgan(r2,2048) Tanimoto nearest-neighbour similarity below the 0.40 Bajusz-Racz-Heberger cutoff (range 0.1579-0.3929), and the IPDA structural correction leaves the Morgan nearest-neighbour similarity unchanged, so the headline never depended on the defective cells.
method: Identical pipeline to R-A07 and to the refuting audits: '*'->'C' methyl cap; canonical RDKit SMILES dedup (structure-only, label-free); families morgan_r2_2048 / maccs_166 / atompair_2048 / toptorsion_2048; leave-one-out nonconformity alpha_i = 1 - NN_LOO(i); candidate alpha_x = 1 - max_j Tanimoto; conformal p = (#{alpha_i >= alpha_x} + 1)/(n + 1); NOVEL iff p < alpha for alpha in {0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20}; fixed-cutoff lane NOVEL iff Morgan NN Tanimoto < 0.40. The ONLY change from R-A07 is that the corrected IPDA structure is used in every family, not just morgan_r2_2048.

ra07_shipped_table_parity_under_old_ipda.note: Confirms V-A07's central finding constructively: R-A07's shipped four-family table reproduces EXACTLY when the OLD, refuted C9H20N2 string is used in all four families, i.e. the structural correction was never applied there.
